source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary:
Once per turn and twice per battle, per unit: when a **[normal move](vsdata:core-rule/normal-move)** by this unit ends in your [Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase), you can pick one **visible** enemy unit no more than 12" from it and roll a D6. A 3+ inflicts D3 **[mortal wounds](vsdata:core-rule/mortal-wounds)** on that unit.

To track uses, place 2 Bomb Squig tokens beside the unit and take one away each time the ability is used.
